verdict.rationale: Rev AI is operated through its async and streaming speech-to-text APIs, SDKs and dashboard. Nothing in the evidence shows a natural-language command interface for running transcription jobs or managing the account. The only related item is a 'Connect to Cursor / Install MCP server' link on the docs site. It looks like docs-site tooling, and there is no evidence it lets an agent operate the product, so it is at most adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
